messages:
rachael: quick follow-up from today's all-hands org chart slide 1 capturing the common Qs here so people have one place to check.
josh: thanks. first Q: are we changing reporting lines for the infra org or just renaming teams?
rachael: mostly reporting tidy-ups, not functional reshuffles. some teams will move under "Platform" vs "Runtime" to reduce dual-reporting. we'll publish a before/after org chart.
priya: will matrix leads still exist? engineering managers worried about dotted-line reporting clarity.
rachael: yes dotted-line/matrix leads remain. new guidance: primary manager owns performance and pay; matrix lead owns day-to-day priorities for the project. we'll add a short explainer doc.
lina: People Ops will post the official org-change doc with manager-of-record, matrix relationships, and a migration checklist by EOD.
matt: question on hiring bands: if headcount moves org, does comp band follow the person or the role?
rachael: comp band follows the person. managers can request band re-evaluation through Comp but transfers don't automatically change band.
cody: any special handling for managers who lose ICs to transfers? need to know if they get backfill immediately or if headcount is pooled.
matt: initial policy: headcount follows the product area. if a manager loses an IC due to org-level reprioritization, they can request a backfill; priority backfills routed first. Finance + People Ops will confirm within 3 business days for priority cases.
priya: where do managers log backfill requests? I couldn't find the form.
lina: form link will be in the People Ops doc, but short answer: finance portal -> Reallocation -> Request Backfill and tag "org-change". we'll pin the link in #all-hands.
josh: will there be changes to promotion calibration panels because of new org boundaries?
rachael: calibration stays company-wide. panels may include managers from new orgs to ensure fair cross-org evaluation. no changes to criteria.
cody: practical ask: can we get a small visual mapping (who reports to whom) rather than a huge PDF? engineers prefer small interactive maps.
rachael: yes  we'll publish an interactive org map and a downloadable CSV.
dev-bot: doc-publish: "people-ops/org-change-matrix.md" at 2470012450
priya: are there any seat/office reassignments tied to these moves or is that separate? some folks ask about desk swaps.
rachael: seat assignments separate. Facilities team will coordinate if moves require desk changes. People Ops will include a Facilities contact.
matt: one more budget Q: if a headcount moves but the new team cannot use the budget this quarter, can the origin team keep a temporary allocation?
rachael: yes, short-term loaning of budget allowed with Finance approval. submit a reallocation with "temporary-loan" note. Finance will return unused headcount to a pool after 60 days if not utilized.
josh: will managers get a list of impacted people before public announcements? we want to avoid surprises.
lina: yes  People Ops will run a targeted outreach to affected individuals prior to org-wide posts. managers get a heads-up 48 hours before public announcement.
cody: onboarding note: for transferred hires, who runs the first-week onboarding checklist? new manager or old?
rachael: new manager owns role onboarding; old manager should run a 2-3 day overlap onboarding for context. checklist will clarify responsibilities.
priya: tiny ask: can we add an FAQ for ICs about career progression when moved? reduces 1:1s.
lina: putting together an IC FAQ and manager talking points. will include promotions, vesting, comp, visas, and where to ask more.
rachael: thanks all. we'll post the org-change doc + interactive map here when live and host a short manager-only sync Thursday 10am PT. :white_check_mark:
__notes: All-hands follow-up thread about org chart mapping, reporting lines vs renaming, matrix leads, comp band policy, backfill process, interactive org map, facilities/desk questions, budget loan policy, announcement cadence, onboarding ownership, and manager/IC FAQs. Short Slack-style messages and a doc publish bot note.
